QUOTE: "`LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`src/inference/llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) does no llama.cpp calls. It forwards to the `Tokenizer` seam and returns `{}` if no tokenizer is wired." and "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` returns an empty `std::vector<int32_t>`" on failure.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. It says the tokenizer layer returns an empty vector on failure. It never says the backend wrapper returns the same empty value for a failed tokenization and for the no-tokenizer case, and the item needs that pairing stated.
